justification: New LLM overlay layer: flag-gated default OFF, additive-only (any failure returns None, base brief untouched), no DB writes. It authors user-visible sentence templates and calls the Anthropic API, so silent wrong output matters (standard); it cannot corrupt stored data or break the existing brief (not critical).

pre_impl.existing_data: Consumes BriefManifest from services/brief_manifest.py (merged #738) and brief dumps from the pipeline; calls the Anthropic Messages API; reads no database.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If a plan references ids or templates outside the manifest/registry, validate_plan rejects it, one corrected retry runs, then SelectionError fails closed to no-overlay.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Pure call-time layer behind BRIEF_LLM_OVERLAY_ENABLED (default off); no stored rows, no existing behaviour changes until a PR-3 caller passes enabled.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Anthropic API errors raise SelectionError inside select_composition; generate_overlay converts every failure to None so the brief renders unchanged.
pre_impl.frontend_type: None yet — RenderedOverlay JSON shape ships to the frontend in PR-3.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: User sees the normal brief with no overlay section; failure is logged server-side.

functions.name: generate_overlay
functions.input: brief model or dump plus persona, optional intent and question, optional flag override and injected client
functions.output: RenderedOverlay for the UI, or None when the flag is off or anything fails
functions.if_none: flag off, unknown intent, API failure, or contract breach all return None with a log line — the base brief is never affected

functions.name: select_composition
functions.input: BriefManifest plus persona/intent/question and an injectable Anthropic-compatible client
functions.output: validated CompositionPlan, or SelectionError after the retry budget is exhausted
functions.if_none: missing tool_use block, schema-invalid payload, or persistent validation failures raise SelectionError which the orchestrator converts to no-overlay

functions.name: validate_plan
functions.input: a parsed CompositionPlan plus the manifest it must reference
functions.output: list of human-readable contract violations, empty when the plan is valid
functions.if_none: gap ids cited as facts, unknown ids or templates, arity breaches, oversize plans, and declined plans without a decline headline are all rejected

functions.name: render_plan
functions.input: a VALIDATED CompositionPlan plus its manifest and an optional caution note
functions.output: RenderedOverlay with deduplicated lines keyed by cited entry set
functions.if_none: duplicate citation sets render once; empty plans yield an overlay with an empty headline rather than raising

functions.name: _incompatible_overlay
functions.input: the deterministic incompatibility reason plus the manifest for citation
functions.output: declined RenderedOverlay built with zero LLM involvement
functions.if_none: only FIELD strata rows are cited; when the strata row is a GAP the fact list is simply empty

functions.name: overlay_enabled
functions.input: optional explicit boolean override, else the BRIEF_LLM_OVERLAY_ENABLED environment variable
functions.output: boolean gate for the whole overlay path, default False
functions.if_none: unset or any value other than true/1 keeps the overlay dark — the fail-safe direction

functions.name: plan_tool_schema
functions.input: no arguments; reads the template registry at call time
functions.output: tool schema whose template fields are enum-constrained to registry ids
functions.if_none: N/A — pure function over module constants

functions.name: _extract_tool_input
functions.input: an SDK response object or a dict-shaped fake from tests
functions.output: tuple of tool input dict and tool_use id, or None-None when absent
functions.if_none: missing tool_use yields None which select_composition turns into SelectionError

functions.name: render_line
functions.input: template id plus manifest and the entry ids the line must cite
functions.output: RenderedLine with verbatim values, provenance suffix and citation ids
functions.if_none: unknown template or id raises KeyError/ValueError — a caller bug, since plans must be validated first

functions.name: render_gap_line
functions.input: one GAP manifest entry with its reason and fallback source
functions.output: a Not-checked sentence naming the reason and where to look instead
functions.if_none: missing reason or source render explicit no-record markers, never silence

functions.name: scan_liability
functions.input: any rendered or authored text destined for the user
functions.output: list of flagged advisory terms found, empty when clean
functions.if_none: empty or None-ish text returns an empty list

functions.name: assert_templates_clean
functions.input: no arguments; scans every authored template phrase at import time
functions.output: returns None or raises ValueError naming the offending template
functions.if_none: a flagged authored phrase is a build error and must fail loudly, not warn

functions.name: label_for_path
functions.input: a manifest dotted path possibly with a list index suffix
functions.output: human-readable label with domain acronyms preserved
functions.if_none: empty path yields empty label which renders harmlessly

functions.name: capabilities_block
functions.input: no arguments; reads the template registry
functions.output: deterministic CAPABILITIES text for the cached Stage-1 prompt
functions.if_none: N/A — pure function over module constants

values.if_missing: overlay stays off — the user-confirmed default; only true/1 enables

values.value: tool_use block in the Stage-1 response
values.if_missing: SelectionError raised and the orchestrator serves the brief with no overlay

values.value: gap entry ids inside a plan's fields list
values.if_missing: a G id cited as a fact is rejected in validation so a failed check can never render as checked-clear

break_it.scenario: Stage-1 cites a gap id under a fact template so a failed overlay query renders as an authoritative-looking empty fact
break_it.what_happens: Reader sees a checked-clear style line for data that was never obtained — the false-negative class
break_it.how: services/brief_narration.py:145 — fact templates validate against entry ids minus gap ids; killed in live mutation run

break_it.scenario: Two legitimately-empty controls render identical marker text and text-keyed dedup silently drops the second field
break_it.what_happens: One of two distinct queried-empty facts disappears from the overlay without any log or error
break_it.how: services/brief_narration.py:381 — dedup keys on the sorted citation-id set, never on rendered text; killed in live mutation run

break_it.scenario: Model declines a forbidden question but picks a factual headline so the decline reason never reaches the reader
break_it.what_happens: Overlay shows declined styling with ordinary facts and no explanation of what was declined or why
break_it.how: services/brief_narration.py:150 — declined plans must use a standalone decline/clarify/not-covered headline template

break_it.scenario: Granny-flat intent on an apartment strata lot reaches the LLM which composes a build plan (live validation 2026-07-15)
break_it.what_happens: Reader receives feasibility-style content for a project their lot cannot legally pursue individually
break_it.how: services/brief_narration.py:437 — deterministic INCOMPATIBLE pre-check renders the decline with zero API calls, asserted in test

break_it.scenario: Retry after an invalid plan echoes the tool_use turn without a tool_result and the API rejects the request with a 400
break_it.what_happens: Every retry fails so a recoverable one-off slip permanently kills the overlay for that request (observed live before fix)
break_it.how: services/brief_narration.py:334 — retry answers the echoed tool_use with an is_error tool_result carrying the violations

break_it.scenario: The overlay feature flag defaults on or misparses a truthy-looking string so the LLM layer serves audiences that opted out
break_it.what_happens: Users see AI-selected content the operator never enabled, violating the user-confirmed default-off decision
break_it.how: services/brief_narration.py:81 — only the exact strings true/1 enable; flipped-default mutation killed in live run

break_it.scenario: Any unexpected exception in manifest build or rendering propagates and turns a working brief request into a 500
break_it.what_happens: The additive-only guarantee breaks — an overlay bug damages the base product it was never allowed to touch
break_it.how: services/brief_narration.py:460 — last-resort handler logs and returns None; exception-propagation mutation killed after adding a direct test

break_it.scenario: Authored template wording drifts from the pre-push liability scanner so the overlay gate and repo gate disagree
break_it.what_happens: Advisory language could ship in overlay templates while the pre-push hook believes user-facing text is clean
break_it.how: services/brief_templates.py:41 mirror + tests compare compiled patterns with scripts/liability_language_check.py; scan-returns-clean mutation killed

post_merge.manual_verify: No — flag stays off in production until PR-3 wiring
